data_hygiene.leakage_definition: Exact (AGE, SEX, sorted(EVIDENCES), PATHOLOGY) match against sampled clean training set dropped from validation and test splits

dataset.representation: DDXPlus patient evidence lists expanded into schema-defined sparse symptom and antecedent features; INITIAL_EVIDENCE excluded because not collected at inference

preprocessing.method: schema-fixed one-hot evidence encoding; no validation/test-fitted statistics

dataset.missing_interpretation: Empty evidence tokens mean evidence not reported; original DDXPlus data are synthetic.

split_overlap_fingerprints.scope: all raw records; cross-split duplicate rows counted against any prior split

data_hygiene.leakage_definition: Exact (AGE, SEX, sorted(EVIDENCES), PATHOLOGY) match against sampled clean training set dropped from validation and test splits

overlap_fingerprints.scope: all raw records; cross-split duplicate rows counted against any prior split

training.selection_metric: realistic validation macro-F1 after RandomizedSearchCV on the training split (test split untouched)

baselines.interpretation: Majority-class score is a naive floor; nearest-neighbour tests whether local evidence-pattern similarity beats the selected classical models. Nearest-neighbour evaluation uses a deterministic bounded slice for laptop memory.

calibration.brier_definition: Validation multiclass Brier score is mean sum of squared class-probability errors.

explainability.method: SHAP TreeExplainer (tree-path-dependent, raw margin units; zeros passed as missing to match sparse training)
explainability.units: mean absolute SHAP value (model output contribution); not causal effect

urgency.label_source: DDXPlus per-pathology severity; synthetic dataset-defined proxy, not clinician-validated. Lower severity number means more severe.
urgency.rule_context: TypeScript rule engine script was skipped or environment lacks Node.js.

limitations: DDXPlus is synthetic and not clinical validation.
Sampling limits training to the configured row budget; validation/test samples are proportional.
No patient identifier is distributed, so split checks use exact-row fingerprints only.
Age 50 is assigned to elderly to resolve overlapping app questionnaire ranges.
Urgency labels derive from dataset severity and are not clinician-validated.
Project safety choices are not clinical guidelines.
Learning curve uses the full augmented training set across four fractions.
disclaimer: This is not a medical diagnosis. Consult a qualified clinician.
